runs.text:
Process bus
L2 Ethernet · PRP / HSR · SV (9-2 LE) + GOOSE + PTP (9-3)

Station bus
Ethernet (PRP) · MMS + GOOSE + PTP

Station-bus tap
SPAN (RO) · MMS + SOE + GOOSE

Asset-cond aggregator
RS-485 · 4-20 mA+HART · Modbus TCP ·
DNP3 · 61850 MMS · SNMP

Security aggregator
RTSP/ONVIF · OSDP · BACnet MS/TP ·
dry contacts · NVR API

SME workstation
PyQt6 UI
State Viewer · bus emulator ·
LLM loop · session console

Cellular modem
4G LTE / 5G NSA
APN + IPsec VPN
MQTT / HTTPS uplink

SME phone notify
SMS / push call-out

Utility control centre
EMS / DMS / OMS
DNP3 / 60870-5-104

Read-only by design.
Passive listener on both buses (SPAN/mirror);
never publishes GOOSE, never commands MMS,
never trips a breaker. Surfaces evidence to the SME.

Seal contract gates GPU power.
SEALED ⇄ AWAITING_SME ⇄ INVESTIGATION is the
SME flow. GPU unpowered in SEALED.

One time domain.
The substation PTP grandmaster disciplines both
buses AND the edge compute's signal-plane clock
(origin_ns sealed at ingest).

Physical-security feeds are read-only too —
capture + correlate, never command. Camera + PD
cross-correlation is a target Stage 7e+ use case.
